Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 29
Reason for Mistake: At this step the Orchestrator introduced a flawed plan that permitted “hypothesizing” the fish-bag volume if the exact value could not be found in the PDF. This shifted the workflow from evidence-based extraction to guessing. Without any agent having located the value in the paper, the process culminated in an unsupported final answer of 12.6 rather than the correct 0.1777 m³.
